title: Failure
description: The classification of a failure (REQ-FLT-001): a code from the catalog in contracts/errors/, its category, its severity and whether it is recoverable. Its use in fault.* events belongs to T-07.3.

code.description: A stable code of contracts/errors/catalog.yaml: lowercase snake_case.

recoverable.description: True if the caller may retry or continue; false if the failure cannot be recovered from.
